**Cover Letter – Junior Product Designer, Monzo**

*Name omitted for privacy*

Dear Monzo Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Product Designer position. With two years of experience as a barista, I honed my ability to observe user needs, manage urgent requests, and communicate clearly under pressure—skills that translate directly to a fast‑paced fintech environment.

Outside the café, I taught myself Figma and design fundamentals through online courses and hands‑on projects. One of my recent projects involved building a prototype mobile app that leverages AI to suggest personalized savings goals. The app, developed entirely in Figma, combines clean UI, intuitive flows, and a smart recommendation engine—demonstrating my capacity to blend design with emerging technology.

I am drawn to Monzo’s mission of creating an inclusive, user‑centric banking experience. I am eager to contribute my fresh perspective, quick learning curve, and passion for crafting delightful product experiences that make banking easier for everyone.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my background and enthusiasm can support Monzo’s growth.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
